$Comment: Martha the Cook, the feast's host, who sets out a long table in the Forgotten Temple while Harvest Feast runs. A thin Variant: Template_Zig_QuestGiver, shipped by Ziggfreed's CommonLib, holds the whole body (standing, watching, the press-F action), and this file only says how the host looks, what she holds and how she reads. Modify may name only the five parameters that template declares: Appearance, NameTranslationKey, Weapons, OffHand and DefaultOffHandSlot. Naming anything else makes the game refuse the whole role, and the only sign in game is a host who never appears. Appearance is this pack's own model (Models/Harvest_Feast/NPC/Harvest_Feast_Host.json), built from the game's own pieces. OffHand puts the game's lumberjack lantern, an item players carry like a torch, in her off hand, and DefaultOffHandSlot 0 has her hold it from the start; Weapons is left out, so her main hand stays empty. Swap the lantern for any other item id a player can hold, or drop both keys to empty her hands. NameTranslationKey is the nameplate, in this pack's npcs.lang. NpcPlacements/Harvest_Feast_Host_Temple.json stands the host in the temple, and only while the feast runs.
